text:
Ingest (ingest.py) is waiting on the batch ceiling we locked in last week. limiter.yaml already has concurrency, the window, and max inflight; leave those three as they are.

Set the batch ceiling in limiter.yaml and run sh ./fb2-03-gate.sh.
